core.title: 10 x 34 Inch Polished Brass Kickplate, Don-Jo KP-10x34-605

text.description_html:
Polished Brass 10" x 34" Kickplate

This 10" x 34" Inch Polished Brass Kickplate is primarily used on commercial doors such as those in restaurants, warehouses, and stores; but it can be used in your home as well. It is made of .050" thick, high quality solid brass. This Kick Plate is 10" wide and 34" long. Comes packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Also Available: 10" x 34" Stainless Steel Kick Plate

Specifications of the KP-10x34-605 Solid Brass Kick Plate:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Plate Height: 10"
  • Plate Width: 34"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with mounting screws.

Note: Kick Plates are typically the width of the door less 2 inches. If your door is 36 inches wide you would install a 34 inch wide kick plate. Please measure your door/s for proper fit.

Sold Individually
